spec.title: Deployment layers across architecture stacks

layers.label: Layer 4: monitoring
items: Cloud Monitoring dashboards track infrastructure and system metrics.
Replication lag alerts flag delay across standby database replicas.
Replica sync state tracking confirms health across data nodes.
ILB health telemetry routes network traffic away from failed nodes.

layers.label: Layer 3: database
items: WSFC cluster manages quorum voting and automated instance failover.
SQL Server Enterprise hosts business databases with failover support.
Always On AG coordinates synchronous database standby replication.
Cloud Witness provides a lightweight quorum tie-breaker in storage.

layers.label: Layer 2: compute
items: Multi-zone VMs distribute compute capacity across failure domains.
Persistent Disks deliver durable block storage for database files.
Local SSD tempdb delivers low latency scratch storage for queries.
Active Directory nodes provide domain authentication for clusters.

layers.label: Layer 1: network
items: VPC and subnets isolate database environments across regional zones.
Internal load balancers route application traffic to primary nodes.
Cloud DNS zones resolve database listener names for client hosts.
IAP firewall rules restrict administrative network ingress points.

spec.notes:
66degrees structures the deployment into four sequential layers so foundational networking and DNS resolution are verified before Compute Engine instances and SQL Server clusters are provisioned. Layer 4 completes the stack by binding Cloud Monitoring alerts to replication lag and load balancer health probes.
